note: LinkedIn's per-school people pages return an authwall for automated fetches, so exact alumni counts at each company are not obtainable. Values below are qualitative bands assembled from College Transitions' LinkedIn-derived tech-feeder counts, Resume Genius's Nov 2025 LinkedIn Alumni analysis, workforce.ai's OpenAI alma-mater ranking, and school-published first-destination reports. All values are relative to the 25 schools in this study, not the whole U.S. college population.
